svg.title: Trinity Rise · Four-bedroom apartment, Option A — schematic exploration v1
svg.desc: Four private bedrooms in two wings around a central living room and kitchen on the facade. Two shared bathrooms, in-unit laundry, a study nook, and a flex room. 4 beds. Envelope 56'-0" by 26'-0" (1456 sf) using exploratory dimensions. Not measured, not code reviewed, not for construction.
svg.text: Trinity Rise · Four-bedroom apartment, Option A
Four private bedrooms + two shared bathrooms
4 beds · envelope 56'-0" × 26'-0" = 1,456 sf · 364 sf per bed
SCHEMATIC EXPLORATION · v1 · 2026-11-06 · Dimensions are exploratory assumptions (studies/assumptions.json), not measurements.
Not code-reviewed, not an accessibility determination, not for construction. Orientation not established (no north arrow).
Independent student design study by Ivan Minier, drawn with AI assistance. Not a UVM design or an adopted part of the Trinity Redistricting proposal.
